preconditions: Owned native Linux transaction and independently checked publication model, plan and complete file inventories.
steps: Interrupt a real publication and observe the complete current normative membership and exact bytes.
Complete the bound full target or restore the bound basis; preserve foreign files and all recovery evidence.
Reject additional, missing, changed and concurrently observed resources; compare mutation and read-only diagnosis.

oracle.requirement_contract: Wenn alle Nachher-Hashes einer unterbrochenen Transaktion vorhanden sind und dem Journal entsprechen, MUSS Recovery fehlende Audit- und Request-Receipts aus dem Journal rekonstruieren und die Transaktion anschließend als `committed` abschließen, statt den vollständig veröffentlichten Zustand zurückzurollen.
oracle.scope: Complete supported resource membership and exact byte equality bind the independently prepared basis/target roots through the existing checked journal contract. Explicit Recovery API and observation only; no independent profile reconstruction, automatic recovery, cleanup or complete requirement acceptance is claimed.

open_items: Receipt/audit completion and cleanup remain AUDIT-REC-02; receipt-error mutation accounting remains AUDIT-REC-03.
Interrupted auxiliary recovery writes remain AUDIT-REC-04. Automatic preflight, full fault injection and restore stay in their original later plan positions.
